example_contract_not_applied_or_approved.basis: Proposed engineering draft from actual owner50x32size choice and manufacturer-derived C6 body/vent forming envelope. Desired target origin must be explicitly recorded independently before CAD migration. No human stage approval inferred.

areas.basis: BOARD INTERSECTION of existing engineering forming projection x3.5..26.5,y±7 relative to proposed desiredC6origin102.5,106.75. Original two-face scope needs explicit reconciliation with current F-only implementation before use. No normative protection claim.

blocks.basis: Manufacturer-specific high-side buck assessment plus TI layout principles; root must verify illustrative object pin references and set quantitative acceptance evidence before use.

sensitive_nets.rationale: Route sensing and BP decoupling according to manufacturer-specific floating-source buck requirements; keep measurement copper away from switched-node force copper. Exact root acceptance metrics must be established from power assessment, not generic GND rules.

switching_nodes.rationale: High-side source/inductor commutation context requires manufacturer-specific topology assessment; a net called SOURCE is not automatically quiet ground. Minimize unnecessary switched copper while retaining qualified thermal paths.

return_paths.rationale: Explicitly distinguish DC_RETURN from floating SOURCE; no automatic connection or undifferentiated plane. Measure actual critical loop conductors and avoid shared sense/force impedance.

loops.rationale: Document actual commutation and BP local loops from the manufacturer schematic before altering paths; minimum area/length and post-route topology checks belong in linked requirement evidence.

kelvin_connections.rationale: Keep separate sense takeoffs/force-current conductors where specified by the actual circuit. Shared net identity or clean DRC does not establish Kelvin routing.
